# Mapping Specification: WEB_ORDERS

**Source file:** data/raw/web_orders.csv
**Data source name:** WEB_ORDERS
**Entity type:** Person
**Generated by:** mapping_workflow

## Field Mappings

| Source Field | Senzing Attribute | Transformation | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| order_id | RECORD_ID | verbatim | Stable natural key, 100% unique |
| (constant) | DATA_SOURCE | `WEB_ORDERS` | Root attribute |
| (constant) | RECORD_TYPE | `PERSON` | Own feature object; every row is an individual customer, no organization records, no type field |
| first_name | NAME_FIRST | verbatim | Same NAME object as NAME_LAST |
| last_name | NAME_LAST | verbatim | Parsed name parts supplied by the source, so not NAME_FULL |
| email | EMAIL_ADDRESS | verbatim | |
| phone | PHONE_NUMBER | verbatim | Three formats in the source; emitted as-is |
| street | ADDR_LINE1 | verbatim | One ADDRESS object with the three below |
| city | ADDR_CITY | verbatim | |
| state | ADDR_STATE | verbatim | ~6% lowercase in the source; emitted as-is |
| zip | ADDR_POSTAL_CODE | verbatim | ~5% ZIP+4; emitted as-is |
| order_date | payload `order_date` | verbatim | Transaction attribute, not used for matching |
| order_total | payload `order_total` | verbatim | Transaction attribute, not used for matching |

Blank values are omitted; a feature object is written only when at least one of its attributes is present.

## Mapping Decisions

- One master schema (web_orders), no child, lookup or relationship schemas; no embedded second entity.
- Values are routed, never rewritten: the source's lowercase states, ZIP+4 codes and mixed phone formats are left for Senzing to standardize.
- Payload keys `order_date` and `order_total` are not registered feature attribute names.
- Cross-source collision check: first source mapped, so no pairs yet.

## Quality Notes

- Source quality score 89.5 (Strong). Output population equals source presence: NAME 100%, EMAIL 97.8%, ADDRESS 80.2%, PHONE 69.3%.
- sz_json_analyzer.py: no errors or warnings (4,500 records). sz_verbatim_check.py: all values verbatim. sz_routing_report.py: only order_id listed as dropped (it is RECORD_ID).
- The verbatim and routing scripts read JSONL only, so they ran unmodified on a CSV-to-JSONL copy of the source (known tool limitation).
- Structurally validated; semantic validation happens at Data processing's match-key audit.
